name: rewind-demo-video
description: README demo video of REWIND, made with Remotion (see README.md here).

scripts.prepare-assets: mkdir -p public/fonts public/cursors public/sfx && cp ../../assets/background.mp3 public/ && cp ../../frontend/public/cursors/*.png public/cursors/ && cp ../../frontend/public/audio/chimes/bells.mp3 public/sfx/ && (test -f public/fonts/vcr-osd-mono.ttf || (wget -qO /tmp/vcr.zip 'https://dl.dafont.com/dl/?f=vcr_osd_mono' && unzip -p /tmp/vcr.zip '*.ttf' > public/fonts/vcr-osd-mono.ttf))
